article.story: PHILADELPHIA -- — Trey Cornist totaled 114 yards and one of Connecticut's four rushing touchdowns and the Huskies beat Temple 34-20 on Saturday. Cornist did his damage on seven carries for UConn (3-3). The Huskies also had touchdown runs from Kenji Christian, quarterback Kalieb Osborne and Cyncir Bowers, who had 84 yards on 18 rushes. Osborne had a 12-yard touchdown run to give UConn a 7-0 lead to start the game and finished with 257 yards on 17-for-23 passing. Temple's Ajani Sheppard connected with JoJo Bermudez for a 79-yard touchdown on the next play from scrimmage to tie it. Christian broke free for a 39-yard touchdown run on his only carry of the game and the Huskies moved back in front. The Owls (2-4) answered with a trick-play touchdown, tying it 14-all on wide receiver Colin Chase's 29-yard touchdown pass to Peter Clarke. Carl Hardin's 26-yard field goal gave Temple a 17-14 second-quarter lead. Cornist had a 51-yard run before scoring from a yard out as the Huskies took a 21-17 lead and never trailed again. UConn turned an Owls turnover into a 21-yard field goal by Jack O'Connor on the final play of the half. Hardin's 29-yard field goal accounted for the only points of the third quarter and cut it to 24-20. Bowers ran it in from 8 yards out on the 10th play of a 62-yard drive to stretch the lead to 11 with 7:52 remaining. O'Connor capped the win with a 27-yard field goal with 1:05 left. Sheppard finished with 260 yards on 19-for-25 passing. Up next Connecticut: Hosts Massachusetts on Oct. 23. Temple: Hosts Charlotte on Saturday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here.
